architecture: v12c node gate, 100->16->1 Tanh, identity initialized, original A backbone frozen/eval
inherit: All v12c seeds, periods, support eligibility, Adam settings, batch sizes, 12-epoch budget, regularization coefficient, selection constraints and bootstrap settings. Run both node arms afresh, matching initialization and sample order per seed. Never reuse a v12c scalar fit as this global node arm.

objectives.global: Original v12c all-valid-cell standardized flow MAE plus unchanged identity penalty.
objectives.regional: For each fit minibatch: arithmetic mean of candidate H1-H6 mean MAE, candidate H7-H12 mean MAE, and noncandidate all-horizon mean MAE, in standardized flow units; plus unchanged 0.001 candidate gate identity penalty. All three regions must have valid cells, otherwise fail rather than silently reweight.

selection: Unchanged v12c strict incident_full global MAE improvement subject to all original region/cohort 0.1% point-harm constraints. Epoch 0 is always available. Do not choose by regional loss, diagnostic gradients or audit outcomes.

parameter_gradient_probe.sample_rule: Evenly spaced positions from ordered eligible fit incident_full indices, using linspace integer positions, determined solely by manifest eligibility. All eligible indices when fewer than 64.
parameter_gradient_probe.target: Gradients with respect to actual shared node-gate parameters, including all layers, for pooled fixed-probe regional mean standardized MAE and candidate mean identity penalty. Save vectors, parameter names/shapes and sample IDs. Report raw region cosine and directional alignment with global and regional objective gradients, with and without penalty.
parameter_gradient_probe.boundary: Fit positive samples only. No parameter updates, no control/selection/audit gradient targets. Probe is a fixed descriptive subset, not the full fit set and not the Adam minibatch trajectory. Preserve RNG state around diagnostics.

audit: Report A, global-node and regional-node for every seed using the inherited paired week/four-week bootstrap and all cohorts/regions. No best seed or arm chosen from audit; these audit weeks were already inspected in v12c and are not independent confirmation.
